body:
Add three machine-wide settings to `~/.config/solace/config.toml` (or `$SOLACE_CONFIG`), next to `[[models]]` and `task_timeout`. Expose them through the board API and add controls for them on the Settings page.

### Settings

| Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| involvement | `director`, `collaborator`, `engineer` | `collaborator` |
| detail | `concise`, `standard`, `thorough` | `standard` |
| asking | `often`, `balanced`, `rarely` | `balanced` |

### Notes

- The Settings page's other values are kept in the browser (`settings.gleam`, `store.mjs`). These three must be read from and written to the server, because the server builds briefs.
- Each choice has a short popup explanation in plain words on the Settings page, hidden unless focus/hover of the element.
- An unknown or missing value falls back to the default. It is never an error.
title: settings: agent behaviour in machine config
